title: George Joannides DRE and Oswald Files
metaDescription: George Joannides was a CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald, as named in public NARA titles indexed here.
h1: George Joannides as CIA case officer for the DRE
lede: George Joannides was a CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald’s period as recorded in the figure packet. BlackVaultDocs’ figure hub matches the name George Joannides in document titles from public NARA releases. The hub is a title index, not a finding on the DRE and not a file count. PDFs remain on the originating archive.

sections.h2: What the Joannides figure hub lists
paragraphs: The figure slug george-joannides groups indexed titles that name George Joannides. The packet supplies no document count, so this page does not invent one. The public-record identity in the harvested blurb is: CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald’s period as far as that blurb records the clause.

The harvested blurb on this packet truncates at Lee Harvey Oswald’s name. This overlay does not complete the sentence with a year, a city, or a leafleting episode that is not in the facts. What it can state is the fragment: CIA case officer; handled the DRE Cuban exile group; that handling is placed during Lee Harvey Oswald as named in the packet.

DRE is the group name in the blurb. The packet describes it as a Cuban exile group. This page cites that description. It does not expand DRE into a longer organizational history, because that history is not in the facts. A title match is a catalog hit, not a finding that every page of the scan is a DRE contact report.

sections.h2: CIA case officer, DRE, and Oswald as named together
paragraphs: The blurb joins three elements: Joannides’s role as CIA case officer, the DRE Cuban exile group, and Lee Harvey Oswald. Naming them together is a citation of the packet, not an argument that Oswald was an agent of the DRE or of Joannides. This page does not add that argument.

Lee Harvey Oswald has a separate figure hub. This overlay does not merge the two name indexes. The related topic href on this packet is the JFK assassination collection, which is the internal link the packet supplies. Researchers who need the scans should open the originating archive from the figure hub. BlackVaultDocs matches names in titles from public NARA releases; it does not re-host the PDFs.

sections.h2: How name matching works for Joannides
paragraphs: Figure hubs match names in document titles from public NARA releases indexed on BlackVaultDocs. The Joannides hub is that match, not a complete DRE file and not a complete FOIA log. A missing title hit means the indexed title in this ingest did not match the name as implemented.
The all-figures directory lists other people in the same name index. Use the Joannides hub for titles that name him. A DRE title that omits the personal name would not be promised by this name index.

sections.h2: What this page does not claim
paragraphs: This overlay does not argue that Joannides’s handling of the DRE proves a conspiracy in the Kennedy assassination. It restates the packet fragment: CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald as recorded in the harvested blurb. Conspiracy commentary is outside the index.

No NARA ID is in the facts. No document total is in the facts. No calendar year for the handling is in the truncated blurb. Do not attach an invented file count or an invented year to Joannides’s name.

The George Joannides figure hub is the live title list. All figures shows the rest of the name index. The JFK assassination collection href is the related topic link on this packet. Open the originating archive for scans. A later ingest can retag titles; this prose still will not invent a document count.

DRE is named as a Cuban exile group. Joannides is named as the CIA case officer who handled it. Lee Harvey Oswald is named in the same truncated clause. This page does not add a year or a city to that clause. Oswald has a separate figure hub; the two name indexes stay separate.

paragraphs: Cite George Joannides as a CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald as described in the figure packet, as matched by name in indexed titles on BlackVaultDocs. Do not cite a document count from this guide. Do not complete the truncated blurb with episodes that are not in the facts. faqs.q: Who was George Joannides in the declassified files?
faqs.a: The packet identifies George Joannides as a CIA case officer who handled the DRE Cuban exile group during Lee Harvey Oswald as recorded in the harvested blurb. BlackVaultDocs matches the name in indexed titles. This page does not assign a file count and does not invent a year for that handling.

faqs.q: What is the DRE in the Joannides files?
faqs.a: The blurb describes the DRE as a Cuban exile group that Joannides handled as a CIA case officer. That is the description this page cites. The packet does not give a document count for DRE titles. Titles that name Joannides appear on the figure hub; PDFs remain on the originating archive.

faqs.q: How is Lee Harvey Oswald named in the Joannides blurb?
faqs.a: The harvested blurb places Joannides’s handling of the DRE during Lee Harvey Oswald and then truncates. This page does not complete that clause with a city, a year, or an episode that is not in the facts. Open the figure hub and the originating archive for titles and scans that match the name.

faqs.q: Does the Joannides figure hub prove a conspiracy in the Kennedy assassination?
faqs.a: No. The hub matches the name George Joannides in document titles from public NARA releases indexed on BlackVaultDocs. It restates the CIA case-officer role and the DRE handling in the packet. It does not interpret those files as proof of a plot.
